newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 3.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 3.

text.p: These were the main headlines from Estonia's Kuku radio news report on thursday at noon. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tallinn City's budget has only collected 46 percent of projected revenue.
- Sillamae pensioners demand the resignation of Sillamae council chairman Priit Saksing.
